title: azarolus crataegoides var. dulcis
intro: Azarolus crataegoides var. dulcis, commonly known as Arbutus andrachne, is a plant species within the Ericaceae family. It is a small, evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean region and is valued for its medicinal properties and edible fruits. The health benefits of Arbutus andrachne include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve gastrointestinal issues, and support the immune system, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins.
